title: Projects
subtitle: A project keeps the files, memory, tool choices and chats of one stream together.

actions.openInFilesNamed: Open the folder of {{name}} in Files
actions.editArchived: Restore the project to edit it

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: A project keeps the files, memory, tool choices and chats of one stream together. Start one, then put chats in it.
empty.noMatchBody: Nothing matches the search or the filter.

load.projectsStale: Could not refresh your projects. The list below may be out of date.
load.memory: Could not load the memory of this project.
load.agents: Could not load the agents of this project.
load.agentsStale: Could not refresh the agents. The list below may be out of date.
load.connections: Could not load the connections of this project.
load.connectionsStale: Could not refresh the connections. The list below may be out of date.

load.automationsStale: Could not refresh the automations. The list below may be out of date.

toasts.deletedUndo: Deleted “{{name}}”. Its folder is in the Trash.
toasts.undoLate: “{{name}}” is already deleted. Restore it from the Trash in Files.
toasts.noModel: Install a chat model first, then start the chat.
toasts.trashedUndo: Moved “{{name}}” and its files to the Trash. Restore the folder from the Trash in Files.
toasts.pullFailed: The chat was created, but the project was not pulled in: {{message}}. Open the chat settings to pull it in.

archivedNote: This project is archived. Restore it to start chats in it.

overview.startBody: A new chat gets this project's files, memory and tool choices.
overview.noChats: No chats in this project yet.
overview.waitingBody: Notes proposed for this project are waiting for your answer: {{count}}.

files.title: Files of this project
files.body: Files you add here are what this project's chats and agents can use.
files.empty: No files yet. Drop files here or upload them.
files.dropOver: Drop to add to this project
files.loadFailed: Could not load the files of this project.
files.archivedNote: This project is archived. Restore it to add or create files. The files stay readable.

chats.title: Chats in this project
chats.empty: No chats in this project yet.

memory.title: Project memory
memory.body: A short index that every chat in the project reads, and topic files it reads when needed.
memory.proposals: Chats propose changes to the memory. You confirm each one before it is written.
memory.sheetBody: Changes apply to every chat in this project.
memory.newHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. It must end in .md.

errors.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, ending in .md (up to 64 characters before .md).
errors.exists: A file with this name exists.

memory.tooLarge: This file is too large to edit here.

tools.title: Tool defaults
tools.connectorsHint: Only these MCP connectors (the ones you add on the MCP connectors page) are on. Messaging apps are separate: see the Connections tab.
tools.collectionsHint: Only these knowledge collections are available in new chats and to project agents.
tools.lead: Empty means no limit. When you fill in a list, new chats in this project start with only those entries on, and every agent of this project can use only those entries.
tools.skillsHint: Only these skills are on in new chats and open to project agents. Use the name shown on the Skills page.
tools.addonsHint: Only these add-ons are on in new chats and open to project agents.
tools.mcp_serversHint: Only these MCP servers are on. Use the server name from a model's configuration.

state.missingTitle: Nothing named “{{name}}” is installed here. This entry does nothing until it exists.
state.offTitle: “{{name}}” is switched off. This entry does nothing until it is on.
state.outsideTitle: {{name}} is not in the limit, so the server refuses this project.

tools.pickerNone: Nothing installed to pick from. Type a name instead.
tools.archivedNote: This project is archived. Restore it to change its tool defaults.
tools.attachedKind: Always on for this project's chats and agents
tools.limitKind: Limit: only these can be used
tools.attachedLead: Every chat and agent of this project gets these on, with no step of its own, also in chats that already exist. A chat cannot switch them off. When the limit below has entries, an attached entry must be in it.
tools.outsideLimit: Outside the limit: {{names}}. Add them to the limit below or detach them. The server refuses a project like this.
tools.attachedBlocked: Attached tools are off while this folder has other writers: what the project attaches is ignored until nobody else can write the folder.

attachedHints.skills: These skills are on in every chat and agent of this project. Use the name shown on the Skills page.
attachedHints.addons: These add-ons are on in every chat and agent of this project. An add-on that holds a credential runs only for you, not for people the project is shared with.
attachedHints.mcp_servers: These MCP servers are on in every chat and agent of this project. A server that holds a credential runs only for you.
attachedHints.connectors: These MCP connectors are on in every chat and agent of this project. A connector runs only for you, never for people the project is shared with.
attachedHints.collections: These knowledge collections can be searched in every chat and agent of this project.

sheet.newBody: Name it and say what it is for. You can add files and memory afterwards.
sheet.editBody: Change the name, the description or the tool defaults.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.nameHint: Shown in lists. Folder: Projects/{{slug}} (it does not change if you rename the project)
sheet.nameHintNew: Shown in lists. The folder is made from the name.
sheet.descriptionHint: One or two sentences. The first {{limit}} characters are given to chats as context.

composer.label: Project
composer.title: Start this chat in a project
composer.heading: Start this chat in
composer.startNote: This chat starts in {{name}}: its files, memory and tool choices apply.
composer.fencedHint: A chat of an agent that has a folder works only in that folder, so it cannot be in a project.

chat.calloutBody_one: Its files and memory are mounted read-only at the pulled path. This chat can still reach the same files through your home folder.
chat.calloutBody_other: Their files and memory are mounted read-only at the pulled paths. This chat can still reach the same files through your home folder.
chat.pulledArchivedTitle: {{name}} is archived and not mounted in this chat
chat.pulledUnavailableTitle: {{name}} is unavailable and not mounted in this chat
chat.sharedNoteRead: {{name}} is shared by {{owner}}: read only for you.
chat.sharedNoteWrite: {{name}} is shared by {{owner}}: this chat can change its files, but notes are proposed and {{owner}} confirms them.
chat.sharedNoteTail: The same folder is also reachable as an ordinary shared folder, so pulling it in is a convenience, not a protection.
chat.unlistedTitle: A shared project is not available now.
chat.unlistedBody: It is not mounted in this chat. The list of shared projects may be incomplete right now, so check again. Or remove it from the chat.
chat.moreTitle: {{count}} more pulled projects. Show them in the settings of this chat.

settings.title: Project
settings.lead: A project gives this chat its files, memory and tool choices. Changes apply from the next message.
settings.pulledHint: Other projects this chat can read. Up to {{max}}.
settings.limit: This chat has pulled in the most projects it can ({{max}}).
settings.noneToAdd: No other active project to pull in.
settings.busy: A turn is running. Try again when it finishes.
settings.gone: The home project of this chat no longer exists.
settings.unavailable: Projects are not available right now.
settings.homeHint: Only your own projects can be the home project.
settings.sharedHint: In a chat that pulls in a shared project, memory is read-only. Notes are proposed and its owner confirms them.

agents.title: Agents in this project
agents.lead: A project agent works only in this project's files and memory. Shared folders and skills stay readable.
agents.archivedHint: This project is archived. Restore it to add agents or chat with them.
agents.empty: No agents in this project yet
agents.emptyBody: Create an agent that chats here and can run on its own.
agents.reconnected: {{name}} is connected to the project again.

reason.archived: Its project is archived. Restore the project to use it.
reason.deleted: Its project was deleted. Restore the project to use it.
reason.changed: Its project folders changed. Reconnect it to work in this project again.

connections.title: Messaging connections
connections.lead: Messages from these apps are answered by an agent of this project, in this project's files and memory.
connections.archivedHint: This project is archived. Restore it to add connections.
connections.noAnswerHint: No agent of this project can answer now. Check the Agents tab.
connections.noAgentBody: A project agent answers these messages. Create one first.
connections.noneBody: Connect a messaging app, and a project agent answers there.

automations.archivedBody: Triggers and loops are paused and resume when you restore it.
automations.triggersLead: Run a project agent on a schedule, or when a file lands in a folder.
automations.triggersNoneBody: A trigger runs a project agent on a schedule, or when a file lands in a folder.
automations.loopsLead: Loops in chats of this project's agents.
automations.loopsNoneBody: A loop keeps a chat in this project going until its job is done.
automations.nextFile: Next run: on a new file
automations.pausedWhy: Paused while the project is archived
automations.newArchived: Restore the project to add a trigger.
automations.newUnavailable: No agent of this project can work now, so a new trigger has nothing to run. Open Agents to see why.
automations.triggersDenied: Triggers are not available to your account
automations.triggersDeniedBody: An administrator can turn them on for you.
automations.triggersNoneNoAgents: A trigger runs a project agent, and this project has none yet.

share.dialogIntro: Anyone you share with sees the whole project: files, memory and settings. People with edit access can change its files, memory and settings.
share.sectionHint: Projects other people shared with you
share.noneOwn: You have no projects of your own yet.
share.archivedNote: The owner archived this project. It is not available to you now.
share.brokenNote: This project cannot be read now.
share.archivedBody: It is not available until {{name}} restores it. You can open it again then.
share.pullRecent: Or pull into a recent chat
share.useBodyRead: Pull it into a chat to let that chat read its files and memory. The chat can read it but not change it.
share.useBodyWrite: Pull it into a chat to let that chat read its files and memory. The chat can also change its files. Memory is read-only in the chat: notes are proposed, and the owner confirms them.
share.useBodyArchived: You cannot pull this project into a chat while it is archived.
share.useBodyBroken: You cannot pull this project into a chat because it cannot be read.
share.memoryNote: A chat that pulls in this project reads its memory and does not change it. Notes are proposed, and the owner confirms them.
share.missingBody: It may have been removed, or the owner stopped sharing it with you.
share.off: Projects are off on this server.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: Its folder, with its files and memory, goes to the Trash. You can undo for a few seconds, or restore the folder later from the Trash in Files.
delete.triggers: Triggers of those agents that stop: {{n}}
delete.chats: Chats that keep their record but lose the project: {{n}}
delete.nothing: No agents, triggers or chats depend on this project.

access.agents: Agents are not available to your account
access.agentsBody: An administrator can turn them on for you.
access.connections: Connections are not available to your account
access.connectionsBody: This tab needs the connectors and the agents features. An administrator can turn them on for you.

projectSkills.title: Project skills
projectSkills.body: Skills kept in this project's folder. They are on in every chat and agent of this project and in no other chat.
projectSkills.blocked: Project skills are off while this folder has other writers.
projectSkills.loadFailed: The project skills did not load.
projectSkills.empty: This project has no skills yet.
projectSkills.deleteBody: The skill is removed from this project's folder. Chats and agents of the project stop using it.
